output_list.reason: Integer overflow vulnerability occurs when an arithmetic operation results in a numeric value outside the range of the integer type, causing truncated values due to limitations in the EVM stack.

The rearm dependency vulnerability exists when an arithmetic operation relies on the balance of the caller as the condition for transferring Ether, potentially causing all the Ether in the contract to be permanently frozen.
The delegatecall dependency vulnerability occurs when an attacker can manipulate the argument of delegatecall, potentially gaining control over the contract and executing arbitrary code.

The Ether strict equality vulnerability exists when an arithmetic operation relies on the balance of the contract's balance as the condition for transferring Ether, potentially causing all Ether in the contract to be permanently frozen.
Reentrancy vulnerability occurs when an external call to Ether's balance (this.call.value()) is not checked, leading to potential exploited conditions within the contract.
